purpose: Teach: 瞬時/歳入/排気/後記/稼げる/頂けれ/興行/続出

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、瞬時の判断、何度も求められたな、私も。
lines.en: When we were starting out, I had to make split-second decisions over and over again.
lines.style: Measured, reflective cadence. Light pause before 'over and over' — memory settling in. Voice carries earned weight without strain. Eyes distant but present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。当社の歳入、創業以来、増加傾向です。
lines.en: Yes. Our revenue has been on a steady upward trajectory since our founding.
lines.style: Respectful but assured. Clear articulation of each fact — not deferential, just precise. Warm beneath the formality. Slight forward lean in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の工場、排気対策、最先端だったぞ、当時。
lines.en: The old factory — our exhaust systems were state-of-the-art for that time.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Slight lift on 'state-of-the-art.' Trailing off gently, letting the accomplishment sit. Fond but unsentimental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社史の後記、お父さんの言葉、引用させていただきます。
lines.en: Yes. I'd like to include your words in the company history's afterword, if I may.
lines.style: Formal respect with genuine warmth beneath. Each phrase deliberate, honoring the moment. No rush — letting the request breathe as a gesture of inheritance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 誠実に稼げる事業、それが、信頼に繋がる。
lines.en: A business built on honest work — that's what creates real trust.
lines.style: Calm certainty. Weight lands on 'honest work' — this is bedrock. Slow exhale at the end. Speaking from principle, not performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。ご助言、頂ければ、新事業の方針に、活かします。
lines.en: Yes. I'll take your counsel to heart and apply it to our new ventures.
lines.style: Receptive, settled. Grateful without excess. Each word carries intention. The tone of someone receiving wisdom they actually plan to use.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業者として、興行的成功にも、立ち会えて、嬉しかった。
lines.en: As the founder, I was glad to witness the company's success unfold.
lines.style: Soft contentment. Slight catch on 'witness' — emotion held lightly. Warm, steady breathing. The voice of someone at peace with what they built.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。創業祭の参加希望、社員から、続出しております。
lines.en: Yes. Our staff have been asking eagerly about attending the founding anniversary celebration.
lines.style: Understated pleasure in the news. Light, almost proud lift. Not announcing grandly, but sharing something that matters. Grounded, natural delivery.
